package: P4 — Studio operation and mobile inspection
authorRole: Interaction implementation engineer; this is not specialist approval

decisions.change: Remove the document keydown handler entirely.
decisions.reason: Space and Left/Right were prevented on noninteractive reading targets; Escape also changed the character outside any deliberate player context. Visible native buttons, selection, radios and range provide the supported keyboard controls.
decisions.preserved: Native browser key behavior and existing gallery-to-heading focus handoff. No new keyboard shortcut contract.

decisions.change: Cancel the collection whenever the player leaves the viewport, including its 600ms inter-clip wait; guard scheduled advance against a cancelled collection, hidden document or reduced-motion preference.
decisions.reason: The prior observer cancelled only while the engine was playing, so a settled clip's pending timer could start the next clip offscreen.
decisions.preserved: Explicit collection playback, manual selection cancellation, finite clips and no automatic resume on return.

decisions.change: Report Returning to rest, At rest and Pose inspection accurately; append reduced motion to the current action.
decisions.reason: The former reduced-motion status always said Still pose even after a deliberate Rest or timeline inspection.
decisions.preserved: Status text changes only when its semantic message changes, not on every animation frame.

decisions.change: Keep Both as the starting view. On small screens, show a short Light/Dark enlargement hint, give lighting targets at least 44px height, and give single-theme stages a 280–360px height using available viewport width.
decisions.reason: Theme comparison stays discoverable while a deliberate single-theme choice has room for a larger actual figure. A default change is not justified by source geometry alone.
decisions.preserved: The same character paths, numeric pose and anatomy in both themes. No expression-recognition claim follows from larger rendered bounds.

decisions.change: Move the mobile Feeling label above its navigation row and let the native selector use the width between the two 44px arrows. Allow mobile status text to wrap.
decisions.reason: The prior label shared scarce width with the selector at 320px. The new row leaves more room for long feeling names and status at zoom.
decisions.preserved: Native grouped selection, explicit label, Previous/Next wrapping and focus ownership.

decisions.change: Link The curiosity study within the studio's existing direction disclosure.
decisions.reason: Connect the dedicated project-cue comparison without adding an unrelated scene or a second player to the studio.

skillApplication.applied: Preserve one existing visual system, readable edges, visible focus, deliberate controls and reduced-motion behavior.
skillApplication.notApplied: Marketing-site generation, palette dealing, one-section-per-screen layouts, sales copy, scenery and decorative motion would conflict with this operational review studio and its bounded change scope.

engineerChecks.result: No character geometry, pose or motion engine changes in this package.

freshBrowserEvidence: Collected by the root browser owner separately; this record does not claim native selection, AT speech, zoom, mobile figure size or live preference tests have passed.
requestedRegressionCoverage: Space and arrows on a reading heading/body retain ordinary browser behavior without selecting or playing a feeling.
Actually open, navigate and commit a native selection; compare selected value, heading, status and active element.
Gallery activation focuses the heading and next Tab remains in player; Previous/Next wrap.
Pause/resume/rest, collection cancellation by manual selection, and leaving the viewport during the collection's inter-clip wait.
Live reduced-motion activation stops playback and collection; disabling it leaves a still; reduced-motion Rest and timeline statuses match the action.
Measure matched visible figure height for Both versus Light/Dark at 390px, inspect the longer selector at 320px, and verify zoom/reflow and bounded AT speech.
limits: No browser was operated by this engineer; the root owns that shared surface.
No human usability study, emotional recognition result or comprehensive accessibility claim.
No score assigned, no deployment, no commit and no push.

workflowChanges.source: Nag requested that the entire team inspect the newly installed emilkowalski/skills collection and improve the workflow.
changes: Before changing UI motion, classify its purpose, repetition and input context; keep control feedback separate from intentionally requested character content.
Use platform capability queries for hover and input size. Do not infer touch from viewport width or apply mobile baseline CSS without its causal justification.
Prefer subtraction first: remove animated background paint; retain short interruptible transform feedback with an explicit supplied curve and asymmetric press/release timing.
Preserve native controls, document scrolling, zoom, content selection and browser feedback unless a concrete replacement is present.

Record each observed source issue in a Before/After/Why table with exact changed properties; keep source checks, desktop emulation, physical-device observations and independent craft approval distinct.
After CSS changes, revise the UI freeze and rerun the affected capability, keyboard, reduced-motion and responsive checks. Do not promote untested device comfort to a verified result.
workflowChanges.limits: No browser or physical device was operated by this engineer. No mascot motion, character anatomy or sound was changed.
